# Words people see on their own phone and computer screens every day. The Simplest
# reading level may use these on top of the ten hundred most common words
# (ten-hundred.txt, the Up-Goer Five list from splasho.com/upgoer5, after xkcd 1133).
# They have to stay: the screen says "Password", not "secret word to get in".
